# Posterize

Reduces your scene's colours to a small number of flat steps.

`lfs.posterize` · Colour

## How to use

Start with Levels 4 for a four-step palette per colour channel.\
Connect a Selection to limit the effect.\
Selected splats lose camera-dependent colour variation.

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Geometry you want to edit. Connect a source; an unconnected input supplies no geometry. |
| Selection | `Selection` | lfs.float | 1 | min 0; max 1; accepts per-element values | Where you apply the edit, 0–1: 0 leaves it unchanged, 1 applies it fully. Unconnected means everything. |
| Levels | `Levels` | lfs.int | 4 | min 2; max 32 | Colour steps per RGB channel, 2–32. 2 gives only low and high values; 4 is the default. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Resulting geometry. Connect to another editing node or Group Output. |
